description:
Step behind the detective desk and crack unsolved cold cases. Caseboard is an interactive criminal investigation simulator where you analyze crime scene evidence, inspect autopsy files, evaluate suspect alibis, and pin the red string on the case board to bring perpetrators to justice.

EVERY CLUE MATTERS
Examine realistic evidence documents: chemical lab reports, ballistic scans, torn notes, encrypted digital drives, and timeline logs. Nothing is decorative—every detail could break a suspect's alibi or establish motive.

INTERROGATE SUSPECTS
Review official police interview transcripts and cross-examine witness testimonies. Identify inconsistencies, uncover conflicting chronologies, and expose lies.

INTERACTIVE INVESTIGATION BOARD
Connect clues, victim profiles, and crime scene photos on your tactile corkboard. Group evidence, deduce connections, and build an airtight prosecution dossier.

KEY FEATURES:
• Deep Cold Cases: Complex criminal narratives with branching evidence trails and multiple plausible suspects.
• Forensic Toolset: Toxicological results, audio logs, CCTV stills, and coroner reports.
• True Detective Deduction: No guessing—formulate your arrest warrant based strictly on verified factual evidence.
• 100% Offline & Private: No account required, no ads, no trackers. Play your investigations anywhere, anytime.

Are you ready to crack the case? Inspect the files, question the suspects, and close the file on Caseboard.
promotionalText: Step into the crime scene. Inspect physical evidence, interrogate suspects, and crack unsolved cold cases in this immersive noir detective board experience.
whatsNew: Initial release of Caseboard! Welcome to the squad, Detective. Crack cold cases, analyze forensic evidence, and bring killers to justice.
